content.short: Digital Gold is the new and improved replacement for Bitcoin. This native token fixes and improves all of Bitcoins shortcomings.
content.description: The Digital Gold Ecosystem project is a three token ecosystem that seeks to facilitate people’s entry into digital assets and blockchain technology, while utilizing a gamified approach to providing rewards and incentives to its holders. Digital Silver is the main transactional token of the ecosystem and the product of the virtual mining process. Holders of Digital Gold who also possess mining permit NFTs will earn Digital Silver. Holders of both Digital Gold and Digital Silver will earn the rare Digital Diamond rewards. Only 21 Billion DSLVR tokens will ever be minted.
